models_evaluated: B-mode ultrasound radiomics-clinical logistic model (clinical plus B-mode radiomics score)

links.outcome: Brier score and mean predicted risk in Center 3 before vs after intercept-only local updating
links.effect: Intercept-only updating aligned mean predicted risk with observed rate; Center 3 recalibrated mean risk changed to 23.5% and Brier score decreased from 0.138 to 0.121.
links.quote: The largest numeric change was observed in Center 3, where recalibrated mean predicted risk changed to 23.5% and Brier score decreased from 0.138 to 0.121 ( Figure 5 ; Table S4 ).

links.outcome: Discrimination and calibration of locked model in temporal and external cohorts
links.effect: AUC 0.823 in development vs 0.874 temporal, 0.866 Center 2, 0.870 Center 3; calibration held except Center 3 (36.4% predicted vs 23.5% observed).
links.quote: The locked clinical plus B-mode score model had AUC values of 0.823, 0.874, 0.866, and 0.870, respectively.

links.outcome: Calibration drift from case-mix and event-rate differences at an external center
links.effect: Center 3 event rate 23.5% vs 44.8% in development; mean predicted risk 36.4%, calibration intercept -0.902; PPV fell to 0.594.
links.quote: Mean predicted risk aligned with observed risk in the development, temporal validation, and Center 2 cohorts but overestimated risk in Center 3 (36.4% predicted vs. 23.5% observed; calibration intercept, -0.902).

links.outcome: Performance variation across sites and ultrasound devices
links.effect: AUC stable across sites (0.823-0.874) but calibration and PPV varied by center; PPV 0.594 in Center 3 vs 0.877 in temporal cohort.
links.quote: Thus, the B-mode score accounted for most of the discriminative performance, and the clinical plus B-mode model did not show a consistent external AUC advantage over the B-mode score-only model.

links.outcome: Predictive values at local prevalence at fixed threshold
links.effect: At fixed threshold 0.565, PPV/NPV were 0.792/0.749, 0.877/0.774, 0.769/0.805 and 0.594/0.897 across cohorts, varying with local event rate.

links.effect: Feature-level provenance incomplete; segmentation repeatability summary available with ICC 0.82.
links.quote: The analytic dataset available for this revision contained the finalized B-mode score, ultrasound platform information, and segmentation-repeatability summary but not all feature-level provenance fields; these provenance descriptors were therefore not used as candidate predictors and are reported as reproducibility limitations.

links.effect: AUC remained high, including Center 3 AUC 0.870, while Center 3 overpredicted 36.4% vs. 23.5%.
links.quote: In the lowest-event-rate external cohort, the locked model retained discrimination but overestimated average risk before recalibration.

links.effect: Adding clinical variables changed AUC by +0.015, +0.008, -0.009, and -0.029 across cohorts.
links.quote: Compared with the B-mode score-only model, adding clinical-ultrasound variables changed the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) by +0.015 in development, +0.008 in temporal validation, -0.009 in Center 2, and -0.029 in Center 3.

links.effect: Center 3 observed event rate was 23.5%, predicted risk 36.4%, calibration intercept −0.902.
links.quote: In Center 3, the observed event rate was 23.5%, mean predicted risk was 36.4%, and the calibration intercept was −0.902.

links.effect: Event rates were 44.8%, 45.2%, 41.0%, and 23.5%; Center 3 had lower baseline risk.
links.quote: Event rates were 44.8%, 45.2%, 41.0%, and 23.5% in the development, temporal validation, Center 2, and Center 3 cohorts.

links.effect: Center 3 recalibration changed mean predicted risk to 23.5% and reduced Brier score 0.138 to 0.121.
links.quote: The largest numeric change was observed in Center 3, where recalibrated mean predicted risk changed to 23.5% and Brier score decreased from 0.138 to 0.121 ( Figure 5 ; Table S4 ).

links.effect: Fixed-threshold PPV/NPV differed across cohorts, from 0.877/0.774 to 0.594/0.897.
links.quote: A threshold optimized in the development cohort did not produce the same PPV/NPV balance in every validation cohort because the local event rate changed.
